## v1.164.28

Unofficial custom build based on the exact official [Storj v1.164.2](https://github.com/storj/storj/releases/tag/v1.164.2) source. This is not an official Storj Labs release.

This updates the previous custom v1.160.28 build to Storj v1.164.2. The original dashboard and estimated-payout normalization PR is now included in upstream Storj; this build uses that implementation directly.

### Differences from official v1.164.2

- Normalize satellite storage-usage gaps in Multinode responses using the same normalization as the upstream node dashboard.
- Add opt-in salvage for hashstore compaction: discard only records proven unreadable or outside a truncated log, preserve readable records, and report committed losses through amnesty with `READ_FAILURE`. Linux `ENODATA` is confirmed by repeated source reads. Limits apply across the complete compaction, and fatal errors still abort the current round.
- Expose compaction progress, rewritten/reclaimed bytes, and salvage counters through `GET /api/sno/compaction`.
- Correct compaction ETA during ordered record rewriting.
- Refresh the satellite trust pool before hashstore recovery and amnesty reporting at startup.
- Add optional target free-space reporting to satellites, with no change to local disk-space calculations.
- Add opt-in manual log compaction. Automatic startup, load-triggered, and periodic maintenance still run in `table-only` mode and apply Bloom filters, expiration, restore, and trash state. Full compaction can be started asynchronously through an authenticated API and processes satellite stores sequentially.

The upstream `Exists` endpoint, hashstore space-usage cache, effective-space calculations, and obligatory hashstore migration are retained. The custom patches introduce no additional database migration or hashstore format change.

### Configuration

All optional custom behavior is disabled by default. Existing settings from v1.160.28 remain valid.

Enable manual control of log rewriting:

```yaml
hashstore.compaction.manual-log-compaction: true
```

```text
STORJ_HASHSTORE_COMPACTION_MANUAL_LOG_COMPACTION=true
```

Enable compaction salvage:

```yaml
hashstore.compaction.salvage: true
```

```text
STORJ_HASHSTORE_COMPACTION_SALVAGE=true
```

Optional target free-space reporting example:

```yaml
storage2.target-free-space: 20GB
```

```text
STORJ_STORAGE2_TARGET_FREE_SPACE=20GB
```

### Manual compaction API

```text
POST /api/sno/compaction/start
Authorization: Bearer <multinode-api-key>
```

Returns `202 Accepted` after registering the job, `401 Unauthorized` for an invalid key, `409 Conflict` if another manual job is active, and `412 Precondition Failed` if manual mode is disabled. Work continues independently of the HTTP connection. `GET /api/sno/compaction` reports the current state and latest job results.

[Storj Compaction Orchestrator](https://github.com/Aleksman4o/storj-compaction-orchestrator) groups nodes by disk, schedules sequential compactions, and displays progress and history using this API. The API format is compatible with v1.160.28.

### Binaries and Docker

Storagenode and Multinode are built by GitHub Actions using this version's official Storj `release.Dockerfile`, `release.docker-bake.hcl`, validation, and ZIP-packaging scripts. Included platforms: Linux AMD64, ARM64 and ARM; Windows AMD64; FreeBSD AMD64. Binaries are release builds with embedded version `v1.164.28` and full debug information.

Docker images contain the same release binaries as the ZIP archives and support Linux AMD64, ARM64 and ARMv7:

```text
ghcr.io/aleksman4o/storagenode:v1.164.28
ghcr.io/aleksman4o/multinode:v1.164.28
```

The Storagenode image preserves the official container's `/app/config` and `/app/identity` layout, ports, `ADDRESS`, `EMAIL`, `WALLET`, `STORAGE`, `SETUP`, `LOG_LEVEL`, `RUN_PARAMS`, arbitrary `STORJ_*` settings, and additional command-line arguments. To switch an existing container, change its image and recreate it with the same mounts and settings. The bundled binary is not replaced by an updater and the official `config/bin` is left untouched.

To update a Compose service:

```bash
docker compose pull storagenode
docker compose up -d storagenode
```

Use a version tag to control upgrades, or `latest` to follow custom releases. Returning to `storjlabs/storagenode:latest` uses the same persisted node data and restores official update behavior. The upstream v1.164.2 migration behavior applies to this release too; returning to older Storj versions is not guaranteed.

### Integrity and provenance

`sha256sums` covers the release archives and container digest files. GitHub Actions signs build provenance through Sigstore. Container images include build provenance and an SBOM; `storagenode-image-digest.txt` and `multinode-image-digest.txt` identify the exact published image manifests.

```bash
gh attestation verify storagenode_linux_amd64.zip --repo Aleksman4o/storj
sha256sum -c sha256sums --ignore-missing
```

The node console does not provide TLS itself. Keep the API on a trusted network, VPN, or HTTPS reverse proxy when using Bearer keys.
